sentences.text: By means of the order dated 15.06.2001 (Page No. 28), the present applicant has been granted bail by this Court.
Thereafter, the present applicant could not participate in the trial proceedings and pursuant to the bailable warrant, she has surrendered before the learned trial Court on 06.08.2024.

She filed the second bail application bearing Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11412 of 2024 (Page No. 38), and vide order dated 07.11.2024, it was dismissed being not pressed giving liberty to file a fresh.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 11412 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Thereafter, the present application has been filed.

The present applicant is in jail in the aforesaid case crime no. 10 of 2001 under Sections 498A,
304B, 201 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the DP Act, P.S. Isanagar District Lakhimpur Kheri.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that she being a lady could not be apprised properly about the proceedings of the learned trial court, therefore, after getting bail in the year 2001, she could not participate in the trial proceedings.
Therefore, the bailable warrant has been issued and she surrendered before the learned trial court on 06.08.2024 and since then she is in jail.
The applicant undertakes that she shall not miss use the liberty of bill if granted and shall participate in the trial proceedings properly.
The present applicant is having no prior criminal history of any kind whatsoever.
Learned Additional Government Advocate has, however, opposed the prayer for bail but he has not disputed the aforesaid submission of learned counsel for the applicant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, perusing the material available on record,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Ramkali @ Rajkumari @ Shanti Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that she shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through her counsel.

In case of his absence, without sufficient cause,
the trial court may proceed against her under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure her presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicants fail to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against her, in accordance with law,
Ramkali @ Rajkumari @ Shanti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin.Secy. Home Lko on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20131742/
2 under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
